market_summary: Across all six asset classes during the London session, price action remains largely compressed inside established session Value Areas and anchored near respective Points of Control (POC). Major FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) display consolidation or false breakout behavior with bearish CVD divergence on GBPUSD, while precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) and BTCUSD hover in mid-channel ranges below their respective session VWAPs and EMA50 baselines with subdued RVOL lacking yellow breakout confirmation. US100 continues to consolidate below Globex VWAP and EMA50 within its session Value Area. With no clean volume expansions outside Value Areas and no confirmed high-RVOL structural sweeps, discipline dictates a universal HOLD across the board.
